# Unmumble

> Learn to understand spoken English. Listen, check, repeat, and hear real English clearly.

Unmumble is a web app for English listening and vocabulary practice. Learners can explore a public phrase library and practise hearing words in spoken examples. Signing in with Google enables account features such as saving phrases and videos, managing settings, and using AI Practice.

AI Practice is an AI chat for learning English words and phrases and practising them in context through conversations. Learners can select useful phrases in the chat to translate them or add them to learning. AI Practice requires signing in with Google.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://unmumble.online/): Product overview and the listening practice workflow.
- [Phrase library](https://unmumble.online/library): Public phrases for listening practice.

## AI Practice

- [AI Practice chat](https://unmumble.online/chat): Learn vocabulary and practise using words and phrases in conversational context. Sign-in required.
